_about: Local changes to STEPBible TVTMS mapping lines (CC BY 4.0). TVTMS asks users who change the data to publish a note of their changes; this file is that note. Each entry replaces the StandardRef of the expanded-data line with the given SourceType and SourceRef. Please report upstream to STEPBible before publishing.

changes.why: Septuagint order in Mal 4:4-6 (Swete, Brenton) is Elijah / turn the hearts / remember the law of Moses, i.e. KJV 4:5, 4:6, 4:4. TVTMS lists the inverse permutation (4:4->4:6, 4:5->4:4, 4:6->4:5).
Rahlfs-style Mal 3:22-24 has the same Septuagint order (Elijah, hearts, Moses); TVTMS again lists the inverse permutation.
